text.p: These are the leading stories in the Ugandan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A group of rebels of the Lord's Resistance Army return to Sudan via Palabek-kal in Kitgum, the biggest number to escape from the Ugandan army so far.
- Defence Minister Amama Mbabazi says the government did not need parliamentary approval to train with U.S. troops.
- President Yoweri Museveni holds a meeting in Kasese, a war zone in Western Uganda, to reorganise the army to win the war against rebels.
- Director of the Uganda Wildlife Authority Eric Edroma resigns after an inquiry reveals that 563 million shillings were misused under his administration. ($1=1075 Ugandan Shillings)
